package controller

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 wfv1 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/util/logging"
)

var isolationCapture func(*corev1.Pod)

func TestOberthIsolationControllerCapture(t *testing.T) {
 dir := os.Getenv("OBERTH_ISOLATION_PROOF_DIR"); require.NotEmpty(t,dir)
 for _, shape := range []string{"dedicated-tools", "none", "container", "script", "containerset", "sidecars", "inline-dag", "inline-steps"} {
  t.Run(shape, func(t *testing.T) {
   data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, shape+"-workflow.json")); require.NoError(t, err)
   var wf wfv1.Workflow
   require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &wf))
   wf.UID = "isolation-fixture"
   sa := &corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.ServiceAccountName, Namespace:wf.Namespace}, AutomountServiceAccountToken:ptr.To(true)}
   executor := &corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.Executor.ServiceAccountName, Namespace:wf.Namespace}, Secrets:[]corev1.ObjectReference{{Name:"executor-token-fixture"}}}
   ctx := logging.TestContext(t.Context())
   cancel, controller := newController(ctx, &wf, sa, executor)
   defer cancel()
   write := func(name string, value any) { t.Helper(); b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(value,"","  ");require.NoError(t,e);require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,shape+"-"+name+".json"),b,0600)) }
   captured := 0
   isolationCapture = func(pod *corev1.Pod) { captured++; write("before-patch",pod) }
   defer func(){isolationCapture=nil}()
   woc := newWorkflowOperationCtx(ctx, &wf, controller)
   woc.operate(ctx)
   pods,err:=controller.kubeclientset.CoreV1().Pods(wf.Namespace).List(ctx,metav1.ListOptions{}); require.NoError(t,err)
   require.Len(t,pods.Items,1,"phase=%s message=%s nodes=%+v",woc.wf.Status.Phase,woc.wf.Status.Message,woc.wf.Status.Nodes)
   require.Equal(t,1,captured)
   pod:=&pods.Items[0]
   write("submitted",pod)
   require.NotNil(t,pod.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken)
   require.False(t,*pod.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken)
   for _,c:=range append(pod.Spec.Containers,pod.Spec.InitContainers...) {
    for _,m:=range c.VolumeMounts {
     if (m.Name=="work" || m.Name=="release-tools") {require.NotEqual(t,"none",shape,"workspace mount injected into none");require.True(t,m.ReadOnly,"%s mount %+v",c.Name,m)}
     if c.Name!="init" && c.Name!="wait" && c.Name!="oberth-executor-token" {require.NotEqual(t,"exec-sa-token",m.Name,"pipeline container received executor token")}
     require.NotEqual(t,"oberth-release-token",m.Name)
    }
    if c.Name!="init" && c.Name!="wait" && c.Name!="oberth-executor-token" {
     found:=false
     for _,e:=range c.Env {if e.Name=="PATH" {found=true;require.Equal(t,"/private/bin",e.Value)};require.False(t,strings.HasPrefix(e.Name,"VAULT_"))}
     require.True(t,found,"%s lost private PATH",c.Name)
    }
   }
  })
 }
}
